# FlowJoe Docs

> User documentation for FlowJoe, a local-first visual workspace.

## Pages

- [Account data and privacy](https://docs.flowjoe.app/account-privacy): What your FlowJoe account stores, where it is kept, and what never leaves your computer.
- [Your FlowJoe account](https://docs.flowjoe.app/account): Sign in at account.flowjoe.app with an email code, see your account, manage signed-in computers and browsers, and change your email.
- [CLI action reference](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/action-reference): Every bridge action: what it does, inputs, examples, results, and approvals.
- [CLI approvals and troubleshooting](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/approvals-and-troubleshooting): Understand approval choices and resolve common connection or command problems.
- [CLI commands](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/commands): The commands and options available in flowjoe-cli.
- [Everyday CLI tasks](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/everyday-tasks): Read notes, inspect branches, edit content, add references, and check results.
- [Change Flow details and automations](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/flow-changes): Edit Flow notes, tags, saved memories, and scheduled tasks.
- [Change references and stacks](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/gallery-changes): Edit gallery notes, organize references and stacks, crop images, and change canvas items.
- [Start using the CLI](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/getting-started): Read, search, and change your open Flow from a terminal.
- [Change nodes](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/node-changes): Create, organize, tag, freeze, and write notes on FlowJoe nodes.
- [CLI scripting and action lists](https://docs.flowjoe.app/cli/scripting): Use JSON, pipes and shared results in repeatable FlowJoe workflows.
- [AI as a collaborator](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/ai-collaborator): Meet Joe: a partner for thinking, creating, and organizing your workspace.
- [Local-first storage](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/local-first): Keep your work close, work offline, and take it with you.
- [About future plugins](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/plugin-architecture): What the planned plugin system means for people using FlowJoe today.
- [Plugins &amp; specialized workflows](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/plugins-verticals): Use FlowJoe for your field today, and understand the future plugin direction.
- [Security &amp; privacy](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/security): Understand where your work stays and what you choose to share.
- [Structure · References · Meaning](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/structure-references-meaning): The core triad that defines every FlowJoe workspace — how order, reference, and intent work together.
- [Ways to Use FlowJoe](https://docs.flowjoe.app/concepts/ways-to-use-flowjoe): Discover how different professionals and teams utilize FlowJoe&#x27;s visual tree and media slots, ordered from professional workflows to creative disciplines.
- [Adding Media &amp; Local Files](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/adding-media): Drag-and-drop, copy-paste, and referencing files on disk.
- [Gallery &amp; Slot Anatomy](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/anatomy): The media hemisphere — slots, cards, and interactive elements.
- [Global Audio Player &amp; Soundtrack](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/audio-player): Vibe to your favorite music, work tapes, podcast refs, or voice logs without breaking your flow state.
- [In-App Browser &amp; Web Clipping](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/browser): Research, bookmark, and clip web references directly into outline slots without leaving your workspace.
- [Canvas Connections](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/connections): Draw relationship lines between slots on the Canvas layout.
- [Image Editor](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/image-editor): Edit a picture in a full editor and save the result as a new version of its slot.
- [Gallery Layouts &amp; Slot Notes](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/layouts): Configure how you view your media and write slot annotations.
- [Slot Preview](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/preview): The full-size view you get when you click a slot, and its rich-text notes editor.
- [Supported Media &amp; Slots](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/slot-types): An overview of supported file formats, previews, and URL cards.
- [Media Stacks](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/stacks): Combine multiple versions or reference takes into a single slot.
- [Tags &amp; Virtual Galleries](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/tags): Flow-wide tags and dynamic cross-cutting search results.
- [Integrated terminal (Forge)](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/terminal): Keep shell sessions and connected coding assistants beside your workspace.
- [Virtual Slots](https://docs.flowjoe.app/gallery/virtual-slots): Show the same slot in more than one node without copying it.
- [The two hemispheres](https://docs.flowjoe.app/getting-started/hemispheres): Tree on the left, gallery on the right, and the divider as your control between structure and visual space.
- [Core mental model](https://docs.flowjoe.app/getting-started/mental-model): Structure, references, and meaning — the three first-class ideas behind every FlowJoe workspace.
- [Quick Start &amp; Onboarding](https://docs.flowjoe.app/getting-started/quickstart): A walkthrough of your first-run welcome wizard and the interactive coach-mark tour in FlowJoe.
- [Organizing Stacks &amp; Tags](https://docs.flowjoe.app/guides/creative-stacks): Learn how to manage design variants and tag references across nodes.
- [Restructuring with Joe](https://docs.flowjoe.app/guides/joe-restructure): Use Joe to organize, clean up, and reschedule your hierarchy.
- [Move a Flow to another computer](https://docs.flowjoe.app/guides/portability): Take your tree, references, and optional preferences with you.
- [Build a Research Board](https://docs.flowjoe.app/guides/research-board): Step-by-step guide to gathering, annotating, and reviewing research materials.
- [Introduction](https://docs.flowjoe.app/index): FlowJoe is a local-first visual workspace for branching, reference-heavy work — structure on the left, media on the right, and an AI collaborator that never owns your tree.
- [Agent Bridge (MCP)](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/agent-bridge): Let a local coding assistant work with your Flow while you stay in control.
- [Automations &amp; Schedules](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/automation): Schedule recurring background AI tasks to keep your outlines, links, and media fresh.
- [Prompting &amp; Best Practices](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/best-practices): Guidelines for writing successful prompts, structuring complex tasks, and working safely with Joe.
- [Bring Your Own Brain (BYOB)](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/byob): Choose Joe’s connection, set up your keys, and use a brain that suits your work.
- [Chat, Analysis &amp; Dictation](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/chat-analysis-generation): Ask questions, analyze spreadsheets, generate graphics, and dictate notes.
- [Context &amp; Memories](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/memories-compaction): Manage token budgets, compact chats, and store attachment summaries.
- [Meeting Joe](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/opening-joe): How to open Joe, interact, and manage active AI chat sessions.
- [Permissions &amp; privacy](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/permissions): Choose what Joe can read and which changes he can propose.
- [Pet Joe](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/pet-joe): Show, resize, and interact with the optional animated companion in FlowJoe&#x27;s gallery.
- [Proposals &amp; approval](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/propose-approve): Turn Joe’s ideas into changes you can review, revise, and undo.
- [Token usage with Joe](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/token-usage): What each send costs, how the token bar works, and how to shrink the flow map.
- [Transcribe audio](https://docs.flowjoe.app/joe/transcription): Turn a recording into text for free on your computer, or use your paid OpenAI API account.
- [Export &amp; Import](https://docs.flowjoe.app/portability/export-import): Transfer workspaces, copy subtree JSON, and save password-protected archives.
- [Storage &amp; preferences](https://docs.flowjoe.app/portability/storage-diagnostics): Check saved data, inspect unused media, and include your preferences in backups.
- [Glossary](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/glossary): Key terminology and concepts used throughout FlowJoe.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/keyboard-shortcuts): Hotkey reference aligned with the in-app Keyboard Shortcuts legend, plus a few extra app-wide keys.
- [Honest Limitations](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/limitations): A transparent list of boundaries and unsupported behaviors in FlowJoe.
- [Rich-Text Editor](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/rich-text-editor): The shared writing surface behind Node Summary, Flow Summary, slot Preview notes, and gallery slot notes — slash commands, emoji, the bubble menu, AI actions, and markdown shortcuts.
- [Settings Map](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/settings-map): A comprehensive breakdown of all application settings in FlowJoe.
- [Status Bar (Footer)](https://docs.flowjoe.app/reference/status-bar): What the bottom status bar shows and what you can change without opening Settings.
- [Tree anatomy](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/anatomy): How a Flow is built: roots, nodes, parents, children, and siblings — the spine of every workspace.
- [Managing Nodes](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/creating-renaming-reordering): Add, edit, duplicate, and organize nodes in the hierarchy.
- [Flow Summary](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/flow-summary): One durable summary for your whole tree, not just a single node.
- [Navigating &amp; Multi-Select](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/navigating): How to move around, filter, and bulk-edit your FlowJoe tree.
- [Repo nodes and Git](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/repositories): Keep a project in its own Git repository inside FlowJoe, review changes, create commits, and work with branches and Git remotes.
- [Status, Themes &amp; Protection](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/status-theming): Visual status indicators, branch theming, and the four orthogonal node protection states.
- [Node Summaries](https://docs.flowjoe.app/tree/summaries): Durable, high-level context summaries for human clarity and AI grounding.
- [Calendar Workbench](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workbenches/calendars): Manage timelines, schedules, and ICS files in a unified view.
- [Rich Document Workbench](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workbenches/rich-documents): Real word-processing islands for drafting documents.
- [Spreadsheet Workbench](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workbenches/spreadsheets): Live, formulas-ready spreadsheets running inside your gallery slots.
- [Chat](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workspaces/chat): Talk with the people you share a Flow with: one group conversation for everyone, and private messages between two people.
- [Workspace Folders](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workspaces/folders): Save a Flow as a normal folder on your drive, so your work sits in plain files you can back up, version, and see.
- [History &amp; Recovery](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workspaces/recovery): Restore points that let you jump back to an earlier version of your Flow, plus the safety nets that keep your work when something goes wrong.
- [Sharing, Guests and Presenting](https://docs.flowjoe.app/workspaces/sharing-and-presenting): Invite people to view or edit a Flow in their browser, see who is where, and walk them through your Flow live.
